name: SentinAI: Autonomous AI Security Platform
desc: Autonomous vulnerability detection that combines Burp Suite-style scanning, API testing and Selenium automation in one pipeline with zero external AI API calls. Chains 10+ bugs into critical attack paths, generates tests, simulates Zero Trust attacks and files Jira tickets with RACI assignment. 1st Runner-Up at MITWPU Ciphathon 26.

name: Krishi Sahayak: AI AgriTech Platform
desc: LLM-powered assistant for farmers covering 50+ government schemes, crop insurance and agricultural credit. Includes an 88% accurate DeepFake Detection Hub for scheme and insurance fraud and a personalised financial-literacy LMS. Best Solution Award among 450+ teams.

name: HoneyPhish: Phishing Detection & Deception
desc: Detects phishing and AI-generated content using 30+ automatically extracted URL and content features, reaching 94% accuracy with sub-200ms scans. A honeypot with fake personas traps and analyses attackers, with a live threat dashboard and Chrome extension.

name: Banana Shelf-Life Prediction
desc: Deep learning research project estimating banana spoilage from images across Day 0 to Day 7 (R² = 0.91). Published a 1,200+ image dataset on Mendeley Data; paper in progress.

name: Cricket Score Prediction System
desc: Random Forest regression on 10+ match features (venue, pitch, form, weather) with about 8 runs mean absolute error. Served through a Django REST API on AWS EC2 for sub-second inference.
